items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So Mills got involved with the band... See, I guess I influenced Mills, because I made this arrangement

ctx.x: So Mills got involved with the band... See, Mills got involved with the band because he was interested in his publishing (?). So that's how I really got close to Cab, because when we used to go downtown to pick songs, I'd go with him, because I could read, and he wasn't that much of a musician.

And he was influential in me taking saxophone lessons. He was sitting back one day with an alto saxophone. I said, "Man, what you doin' with a saxophone?" He said, "I'm taking lessons." He done gone and bought him a Selmer alto and went to Merle Johnson to take lessons. I found out who Merle Johnson, and I went down there to take lessons. And I'll never forget it.
